appraisal_events.evidence: les causeries avec la duchesse ressemblaient à ces connaissances qu'on puise dans une bibliothèque de château, surannée, incomplète, incapable de former une intelligence, dépourvue de presque tout ce que nous aimons, mais nous offrant parfois quelque renseignement curieux... nous oublions... la frivolité stérile [de cette vie]
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator concedes charm, curiosities, and excellent French in Mme de Guermantes' conversation, but the culminating judgment is that it is intellectually shallow and ultimately sterile, a net-diminishing verdict despite the conceded pleasures.

appraisal_events.evidence: il ne me tendit pas la main, ne me répondit pas, ne me demanda pas de prendre une chaise... "Ah! voilà ce que vous appelez un siège Louis XIV! je vois que vous êtes instruit," s'écria-t-il avec dérision... "l'entretien que j'ai condescendu à vous accorder... marquera pour nos relations le point final."
appraisal_events.explanation: Charlus subjects the narrator to a scene of icy contempt and ritual humiliation, denying him ordinary courtesies, mocking him with derision, and formally declaring their relationship at an end, asserting total dominance over him.

status_effects.explanation: Despite conceding her conversation's charm and occasional value, the narrator's final judgment frames it as superficial and intellectually sterile.
The narrator is left stupefied and powerless under Charlus's cold, implacable hostility, unable even to move or respond appropriately.

Charlus denies him basic social courtesies (handshake, greeting, invitation to sit) and formally declares their relations ended, a public-feeling social diminishment enacted in front of the household.
Charlus dominates the exchange entirely, speaking with icy, deliberate, weighted authority and derision while the narrator remains silent and immobile.
